topic.title: Osmosis
topic.description: Predict net water movement from water potential and explain the role of a partially permeable membrane.
topic.learningGoal: Prepare for A-level Biology application questions: predict the effect of unfamiliar conditions on water movement and justify the mechanism.

input.produced: Water moves from the more concentrated solution to the more dilute solution across the membrane.

excerpts.label: Teaching notes
excerpts.text: Osmosis is the net movement of water across a partially permeable membrane from higher water potential to lower water potential. In dilute solutions under the same pressure, increasing solute concentration lowers water potential. Water therefore moves from the more dilute solution toward the more concentrated solution. The solute cannot cross the membrane.

revision.originalProduced: Water moves by osmosis from higher solute concentration to lower solute concentration.

originalComparison.feedback: The direction of water movement is reversed.
incorrect: Water moves toward lower water potential, not away from it.
